<documents>
<document id="cushion-negative-after-dispute">
NegativeˆbalanceˆafterˆaˆdisputeˆYourˆbalanceˆcanˆgoˆnegativeˆwhenˆweˆtakeˆbackˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆafterˆaˆdisputeˆisˆdenied,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆdepositˆisˆreturned.ˆThisˆisn'tˆCushion,ˆandˆitˆcanˆhappenˆonˆanyˆplan,ˆincludingˆBasic.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhappensˆAˆprovisionalˆcreditˆisˆmoneyˆweˆlendˆyouˆwhileˆaˆdisputeˆisˆinvestigated.ˆIfˆtheˆdisputeˆisˆdenied,ˆweˆgiveˆyouˆwrittenˆnoticeˆandˆtakeˆitˆbackˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆlater.ˆIfˆyou'veˆspentˆitˆinˆtheˆmeantime,ˆtheˆbalanceˆcanˆdropˆbelowˆzero.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆyourˆbalanceˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆAnyˆincomingˆdepositˆrepaysˆitˆautomatically.ˆ##ˆFeesˆThereˆareˆnoˆfeesˆforˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆ($0.00).ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆisn'tˆrepaidˆAsˆwithˆCushion,ˆifˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆlastsˆ60ˆdays,ˆtheˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆuntilˆit'sˆrepaid.ˆOnˆPlusˆandˆPremium,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspendedˆwhileˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆnegativeˆforˆlongerˆthanˆ30ˆdays.ˆ##ˆCan'tˆpayˆitˆrightˆaway?ˆMessageˆsupport.ˆIfˆyou'reˆgoingˆthroughˆfinancialˆhardship,ˆweˆcanˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="disputes-denied">
IfˆyourˆdisputeˆisˆdeniedˆSometimesˆaˆdisputeˆisˆdecidedˆagainstˆyou.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆthatˆmeans.ˆ##ˆWhyˆdisputesˆareˆdeniedˆ-ˆTheˆmerchantˆshowedˆyouˆmadeˆorˆauthorizedˆtheˆpurchase,ˆforˆexampleˆwithˆdeliveryˆproofˆsignedˆatˆyourˆaddress.ˆ-ˆTheˆdisputeˆwasˆfiledˆafterˆitsˆwindowˆclosed.ˆ-ˆTheˆmerchantˆalreadyˆrefundedˆyou.ˆ-ˆTheˆissueˆisn'tˆcovered,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆpriceˆyouˆagreedˆtoˆandˆlaterˆchangedˆyourˆmindˆabout.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆtoˆtheˆprovisionalˆcreditˆWeˆsendˆyouˆaˆwrittenˆexplanationˆfirst.ˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆlater,ˆweˆtakeˆtheˆprovisionalˆcreditˆback.ˆIfˆthatˆleavesˆyourˆbalanceˆnegative,ˆaddˆmoneyˆsoˆyourˆaccountˆisn'tˆrestricted.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆappeal?ˆYes,ˆifˆyouˆhaveˆnewˆinformation.ˆReplyˆtoˆtheˆdecisionˆmessageˆwithˆtheˆnewˆdocumentsˆandˆwe'llˆreviewˆitˆagain.ˆWeˆcan'tˆreopenˆaˆdisputeˆjustˆbecauseˆyouˆdisagreeˆwithˆtheˆoutcome.ˆ##ˆNegativeˆbalanceˆSeeˆ"Negativeˆbalanceˆafterˆaˆdispute"ˆforˆhowˆrepaymentˆworks.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="disputes-status">
CheckingˆtheˆstatusˆofˆaˆdisputeˆYouˆcanˆfollowˆeveryˆdisputeˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDisputes,ˆandˆchooseˆtheˆcase.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtheˆstatusesˆmeanˆ-ˆ**Submitted:**ˆwe'veˆreceivedˆitˆandˆareˆdoingˆanˆinitialˆreview.ˆ-ˆ**Provisionalˆcreditˆissued:**ˆtheˆmoneyˆisˆbackˆinˆyourˆaccountˆwhileˆweˆinvestigate.ˆ-ˆ**Waitingˆonˆmerchant:**ˆwe'veˆcontactedˆtheˆmerchantˆthroughˆtheˆcardˆnetworkˆandˆareˆwaitingˆforˆitsˆresponse.ˆ-ˆ**Moreˆinformationˆneeded:**ˆwe'veˆaskedˆyouˆforˆsomething.ˆCheckˆyourˆmessages.ˆ-ˆ**Resolvedˆinˆyourˆfavor:**ˆtheˆcreditˆisˆpermanent.ˆ-ˆ**Denied:**ˆwe'veˆsentˆanˆexplanation,ˆandˆanyˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwillˆbeˆtakenˆback.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆMostˆdisputesˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays,ˆandˆsomeˆtakeˆupˆtoˆ90ˆdays.ˆWe'llˆmessageˆyouˆwheneverˆtheˆstatusˆchanges.ˆ##ˆAddingˆinformationˆYouˆcanˆuploadˆdocumentsˆorˆaddˆnotesˆtoˆanˆopenˆdisputeˆfromˆtheˆcaseˆpageˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆ##ˆCancellingˆaˆdisputeˆIfˆtheˆmerchantˆrefundsˆyouˆdirectly,ˆwithdrawˆtheˆdisputeˆfromˆtheˆcaseˆpageˆsoˆyouˆaren'tˆcreditedˆtwice.ˆIfˆyouˆwereˆcreditedˆtwice,ˆwe'llˆtakeˆbackˆtheˆextraˆamount.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: My dispute got denied. Are you taking the provisional credit back right away?
